title: Histopathological and Transcriptomic Features of Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor-related T-cell-mediated Rejection in Liver Transplantation.
snippet: Immune checkpoint inhibitor-related T-cell-mediated rejection (irTCMR) leads to greater steroid resistance and graft loss compared with conventional T-cell-mediated rejection (cTCMR) in liver transplant recipients.
